# Sam's Menswear

> Custom suits, wedding suits and tuxedos, hand-made by Sam — a bespoke tailor with 30+ years' experience working from his home atelier at 318 Charlton Avenue, Vaughan, Ontario (on the Vaughan–Thornhill line). Sam measures every client personally and, through his traveling-tailor service, brings the fitting to homes and offices across the Greater Toronto Area: Toronto, North York, Thornhill, Richmond Hill and Markham. Specialties: custom wedding suits and tuxedos for the groom, groomsmen and fathers; business suits; hard-to-fit builds; and traditional Jewish menswear (bekishe, kapota, kittel). Rated 4.8★ from 100+ Google reviews. Made to fit — never rented.

## Key facts
- Tailor: Sam Talkar, 30+ years, bespoke and made-to-measure
- Atelier: 318 Charlton Avenue, Vaughan, Ontario L4J 6H4
- Phone: 647-458-0711
- Service area: Vaughan, Thornhill, Toronto, North York, Richmond Hill, Markham (traveling tailor — Sam comes to you)
- Rating: 4.8/5 from 100+ Google reviews
- First consultation: free, unhurried, no obligation, no upsell

## Dressing for your profession (how a suit reads in each field)
- [Senior management](https://customsuitandshirt.com/guides/dressing-for-senior-management): Quiet authority — navy and charcoal, impeccable fit, nothing loud.
- [Sales](https://customsuitandshirt.com/guides/dressing-for-sales): Sharp and credible without out-dressing the client.
- [Real estate](https://customsuitandshirt.com/guides/dressing-for-real-estate): Polished, mobile and market-matched — you are the product.
- [Finance](https://customsuitandshirt.com/guides/dressing-for-finance): The Bay Street code — understated, precise, quietly expensive.
- [Law](https://customsuitandshirt.com/guides/dressing-for-law): Authority and credibility, from courtroom to corporate.
- [Entrepreneurs](https://customsuitandshirt.com/guides/dressing-for-entrepreneurs): The founder's uniform — one great suit that dresses up or down.
- [Medicine](https://customsuitandshirt.com/guides/dressing-for-medicine): Trust and practicality for long days under the coat.
